roms.name: Serial echo
roms.description: Echoes every byte received on 2SIO channel A. Identical to the core's built-in default ROM.

roms.name: Hello, world
roms.description: Prints a greeting to 2SIO channel A, then halts. Watch the register bar stop at HALT.

roms.name: Altair 8K ROM BASIC
roms.description: Mike Douglas's ROM build of Microsoft 8K BASIC 4.0 for the 88-2SIO (10h/11h). Entry at E000h relocates BASIC to 0000h and runs it - no sense switches. Not bundled: put the four 8kBas_*.bin files from deramp.com in web/roms/ (see roms/README.md).
